text: Als DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Architektur, Automatisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer AWS-Umgebungen und entwickelst skalierbare Lösungen, die echten Business Impact erzeugen. Was du bei uns machst Du entwirfst und implementierst skalierbare, sichere und hochverfügbare Plattformarchitekturen auf AWS und anderen Cloud Providern und definierst Standards, Referenzarchitekturen und Best Practices. Du entwickelst und betreibst Plattform-Services wie Networking, IAM, Compute, Storage, Container und Serverless. Du treibst Automatisierung konsequent voran und entwickelst Infrastructure-as-Code-Lösungen (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK) sowie Self-Service-Frameworks. Du gestaltest und optimierst CI/CD-Pipelines, integrierst Security-, Compliance- und Quality-Checks und implementierst moderne Deployment-Strategien (Blue/Green, Canary, Rolling). Du entwickelst zentrale Automatisierungs-Tools und Plattformkomponenten in Python, erstellst APIs, CLI-Tools und wiederverwendbare Bibliotheken und nutzt AWS SDKs (boto3) effizient. Du stellst die Zuverlässigkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Performance der Plattform sicher und implementierst Monitoring, Observability sowie automatisierte Incident- und Recovery-Prozesse. Wann du zu uns passt Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Architektur, Entwicklung und Optimierung von AWS-Plattformen mit. Du hast fundiertes Wissen in Infrastructure as Code, Automatisierung und DevOps-Praktiken. Du bist sicher im Aufbau und Betrieb von Plattform-Services sowie CI/CD-Pipelines und Deployment-Strategien. Du verfügst über gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python und Erfahrung mit AWS SDKs, APIs und Automatisierungsframeworks. Du verstehst Monitoring, Observability und Cloud Operations als integrale Bestandteile einer stabilen Plattform. Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung mit Container-Technologien, Serverless-Architekturen und relevanten AWS-Zertifizierungen (z. B. AWS Solutions Architect Professional). Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Hey, wir sind Skaylink. Begleite uns auf unserer Cloud Journey! Als Part of Vodafone bringen wir unsere Cloud-DNA und Innovationskraft ein. Gemeinsam treiben wir zentrale Cloud- und Transformationsprojekte voran. Von Cloud-Migrationen über Security-Lösungen bis hin zu Modern-Work-Projekten schaffen wir spürbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kund*innen. Dabei nutzen wir Synergien und bündeln unsere Stärken. So entstehen Lösungen mit nachhaltiger Wirkung und genau das macht uns zu einem der führenden Anbieter im Bereich Cloud-Technologien. Unser Anspruch ist es, echte Ergebnisse zu schaffen, die messbar Wirkung zeigen und Projekte nachhaltig voranbringen. Wir beraten nicht nur, sondern setzen um. Denn Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Wirkung zu erzielen, gehört für uns zusammen. Bei uns zählen deine Expertise, deine Leidenschaft und deine Motivation, etwas zu bewegen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen machen uns stark. Sie schaffen den Raum, in dem du dich einbringen und weiterentwickeln kannst. Wenn du nicht nur mitlaufen, sondern wirklich etwas bewegen willst, bist du bei uns richtig. Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica , we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica , you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence. What you'll do Define seeker system requirements and manage interfaces with flight control, avionics, and ground segment teams. Support seeker hardware/software integration and test campaigns. Analyze test and flight data to validate seeker performance against requirements. Collaborate with suppliers and partners on seeker component development and qualification. Maintain technical documentation in line with requirements. Design, model, and analyze seeker subsystem performance at the systems level (e.g. signal processing, detection/tracking performance). Who you are Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a related field. Experience with sensor systems, signal processing, or guidance/tracking algorithms. Familiarity with systems engineering methodology (requirements management, verification & validation). Proficiency with MATLAB/Simulink or comparable modelling tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. What we offer A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from testing and operational activities drives real decisions. A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. Security and Eligibility Requirement Due to the nature of the work done at Hypersonica, applicants must be an EU/Nato/German citizen and be eligible for Security Clearance. At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. titel: Working Student Data Engineer – Python, SQL & Cloud Platforms
text: IMPORTANT Application note Please apply only through this job portal. Kindly do not send applications or recruitment messages by email or LinkedIn. Only applications submitted through the portal will be considered. Thank you. About AgentixLake AgentixLake GmbH is a Data and AI engineering consultancy based in Hamburg, Germany. We design, build and operate production-grade data platforms and AI systems in our customers’ cloud accounts or on-premises environments. We are an AWS Services Partner and a Certified Services Partner in Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network. Our commercial focus is DACH and the Gulf region, alongside selected international opportunities. Your role Build the pipelines and data models that people can depend on. You will own defined components of our data engineering projects, from understanding a source system to delivering tested transformations and monitoring how they run. Our data platform engineering work connects operational systems with analytics and AI applications. Depending on the project, you will work with cloud warehouses, lakehouse architectures and the data quality and reliability practices that support production use. What you will do Build Python and SQL pipelines to ingest and transform data from APIs, databases, files or event sources. Develop data models and dbt transformations with clear definitions, tests and documentation. Implement incremental processing, schema checks and reconciliation so changes and data issues are visible. Configure orchestration and monitoring; investigate failed runs and improve recovery and troubleshooting. Contribute to cloud data platform components, infrastructure configuration and deployment workflows. Use Git, pull requests and code review to deliver maintainable changes and explain their impact on downstream users. What you bring Current university enrolment in computer science, data science, business informatics or a related technical discipline. Strong SQL and practical Python, supported by pipelines or data models you have built and maintained for actual users or team workflows. A sound understanding of data modelling, incremental loads, data quality and the operational behaviour of scheduled pipelines. Experience with version control and testing, plus practical exposure to a cloud platform, warehouse or orchestration tool. The ability to own a well-scoped deliverable, investigate problems systematically and communicate clearly in English. Experience with dbt, Airflow, Dagster, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Apache Iceberg or Terraform is valuable. You do not need experience with every technology; show us where you have developed depth. What you can expect You will work on data systems with clear users and delivery requirements, collaborate directly with experienced engineers and the founders, and receive substantive code review. Your part-time responsibilities and schedule will be planned around your studies. How to apply Use the Apply button on this page to submit your CV, current study details, location and weekly availability. Describe one pipeline or data model you delivered, the decisions you owned and how you tested or improved its reliability. An anonymised example is welcome; please do not share confidential client material. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If the core responsibilities match your experience, we would like to hear from you. Stay connected Follow AgentixLake on LinkedIn for practical engineering insights, project updates and future opportunities. Following is optional and does not influence recruitment decisions. titel: Expert Site Reliability Engineer - Edge Infrastructure (f/m/d)
text: We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you. Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter. Help us see what's possible. Join us. Your Role Orbem’s AI-powered MRI systems run on edge infrastructure deployed directly at customer sites, such as hatcheries and food processing plants. As an Expert Site Reliability Engineer, you will own the reliability, availability, and performance of this growing global fleet. You are the team’s deepest technical authority on the on-premise platform, setting architecture and standards through hands-on expertise. You will own the hardware, network, operating system, and Kubernetes layers that power teams like Data, Machine Learning, and Software. Your Day-to-Day As an Individual Contributor on the expert track, your responsibilities center entirely on deep technical ownership and execution: Edge Infrastructure Ownership Own the reliability and lifecycle of our edge racks: server hardware, network equipment, custom Linux-based OS, and the GPU-enabled Kubernetes layer running our AI classification services. Design and improve automation for provisioning our growing fleet (50+ edge clusters and counting) using tools like Terraform, BMC/IPMI, and router APIs. Maintain the secure network connecting edge deployments to our central cloud, and the tooling that enables safe software delivery to the fleet. Reliability & Incident Management Participate in the rotation of support on weekdays and own triage and resolution for escalated production issues. Lead post-incident reviews and turn findings into lasting, automated fixes. Define and monitor SLOs/SLIs/SLAs for physical edge systems running unattended in the field. Extend our observability stack (Prometheus, custom hardware exporters, Grafana, Datadog) to catch issues proactively, often before customers notice. Architecture, Collaboration & Craft Set technical direction for edge infrastructure projects and contribute to technical planning and ticket writing. Mentor fellow engineers through pairing, design/code reviews, and knowledge sharing, raising the technical bar without formal management authority. Act as the top-level technical escalation point, personally helping resolve the most complex support and production issues. Collaborate with stakeholders (with the eventual support of a Product Manager) to gather requirements and manage technical alignment. Automate away repetitive manual work, applying the same rigor to internal tooling as to a customer-facing product. Your Experience and Skills Container Orchestration: Super proficient in maintaining Kubernetes on edge machines. Programming: Fluency in at least one modern language, such as Golang or Python . Monitoring : Deep understanding of concepts and tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. Terraform is a native language to you. Linux & Server Expertise: Deep proficiency in Linux-based systems and experience with server hardware , including components like RAID controllers BIOS, and Booting . DevOps: Good understanding of release systems and proficiency with GitOps tools like Argo CD. Security Management: Proficient in security concepts like certificate management (issuing, lifecycles, etc.) and secure network tunnels (e.g., IPSec/VPN). What Makes You Stand Out Holistic Data Center Engineering Expertise : Deep understanding of how to deal with low-level hardware like routers, switches, servers, BIOS, and TPM modules . Bare-Metal Automation : Proven experience designing and implementing automation for bare-metal infrastructure provisioning. Modern Kubernetes & CI/CD Architect : Moves beyond basic deployments to architecting sophisticated, automated, and resilient delivery pipelines using cutting-edge GitOps and Kubernetes-native tooling. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Mastery : Expert-level proficiency with Terraform to build version-controlled, repeatable, and scalable environments. Behavioral competencies Strategic Thinker: You develop a clear vision and roadmap for the edge platform, considering its long-term health, scalability, and usability. Strong Communicator: You build strong relationships with development teams and other stakeholders, communicate changes clearly, and secure buy-in. High Ownership: You take end-to-end ownership of your technical output, including reliability, documentation, and continuous improvement. Data-Driven: You use metrics on uptime, incidents, and support requests to prioritize the work that delivers the most value. Customer-Focused: You keep developer and end-customer experience front of mind in your planning and execution. Fit to Our Values We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty. We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving. We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together. What We Offer International Environment: Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges. Comprehensive Benefits: Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success. Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany. Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth. Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass. Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees. Deutschland Ticket: Monthly subsidy towards public transportation costs. Work-Life Integration: Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you. WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us! 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge. Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments. Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year. Make a Difference: Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you. Your Team: You'll become part of our diverse and international team. titel: UAV System Engineer - Data Operations (All genders)
text:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Data Operations team owns the entire data lifecycle behind STARK's AI stack: collection, acquisition, generation, curation, and management. We run our own data-collection campaigns across Europe, evaluate new sensors and platforms, and build the internal data platform that turns raw recordings into ready-to-use datasets. Everything we produce feeds directly into the perception and autonomy systems deployed on STARK's platforms — a real data advantage is built, not bought. The team is scaling up right now: real scope, direct impact, no legacy.

YOUR MISSION

You own our data-collection flights. When the perception team needs a specific dataset — a new camera at a new angle, a lidar over specific terrain, a thermal sensor at dusk — you plan the campaign, configure and tune the platform, fly the mission, and bring clean data home. Our hardware engineer builds the rigs and mounts, our robotics engineer makes the sensors record — you make it all fly, reliably, again and again. This is a role for someone with real stick time and real PX4/ArduPilot depth: not a desk job with occasional field trips, but the other way around.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Plan and execute field data-collection campaigns across Europe: flight planning, site assessment, pre-flight checks, piloting, logging, and post-flight data offload
  • Configure, tune, and troubleshoot PX4/ArduPilot flight stacks for stable, repeatable data-collection flights
  • Analyze flight logs to diagnose issues and continuously improve platform reliability
  • Operate sensor payloads (cameras, gimbals, lidar, GNSS/IMU) during missions and verify recordings on-site
  • Keep the fleet mission-ready: maintenance, repairs, spare parts, battery management, and configuration control
  • Work with our hardware and robotics engineers on payload integration — you define what the platform needs to fly well
  • Maintain flight logs and campaign documentation so every flight produces usable, traceable data
  • Ensure operations comply with aviation regulations (EU drone rules) and internal safety procedures

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Confident, experienced drone pilot with substantial real-world flight hours (multirotor; fixed-wing a plus), holding an EU A2/A3 certificate or willing to obtain quickly
  • Solid practical knowledge of PX4 and/or ArduPilot: configuration, parameter tuning, log analysis, MAVLink basics
  • Hands-on experience assembling, repairing, and maintaining drones — comfortable with soldering, wiring, and multimeter debugging
  • Experience operating sensor payloads and ground control stations in the field
  • Practical, structured, and safety-conscious — you find the loose cable before it becomes a crash
  • Willingness to travel regularly for field campaigns and work outdoors in various conditions
  • Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)

NICE TO HAVE

  • Scripting skills (Python, Bash) for flight log processing and data offload automation
  • CAD basics (Fusion 360, SolidWorks) and 3D-printing experience
  • Experience with ROS/ROS2 recording setups or companion computers (Jetson, Raspberry Pi)
  • Background in FPV, drone racing, RC modeling, competition teams, or maker culture
  • Experience with camera settings and image quality trade-offs for data collection
  • German driving license class B (field campaigns)

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

 

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

To assert your rights as a data subject in relation to the data processed during this online application process, please refer to our Data Protection Officer (see item 2).

Concluding provisions

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Token Factory is a part of  Nebius Cloud, one of the world’s largest GPU clouds, running tens of thousands of GPUs. We are building an inference platform that makes every kind of foundation model — text, vision, audio, and emerging multimodal architectures — fast, reliable, and effortless to deploy at massive scale. To deliver on that promise, we need an engineer who can make the platform behave flawlessly under extreme load and recover gracefully when the unexpected happens.

In this role you will own the reliability, performance, and observability of the entire inference stack. Your day starts with designing and refining telemetry pipelines — metrics, logs, and traces that turn hundreds of terabytes of signal into clear, actionable insight. From there you might tune Kubernetes autoscalers to squeeze more efficiency out of GPUs, craft Terraform modules that bake resilience into every new cluster, or harden our request-routing and retry logic so even transient failures go unnoticed by users. When incidents do arise, you’ll rely on the automation and runbooks you helped create to detect, isolate, and remediate problems in minutes, then drive the post-mortem culture that prevents recurrence. All of this effort points toward a single goal: scaling the platform smoothly while hitting aggressive cost and reliability targets.

Success in the role calls for deep fluency with Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, Terraform, and the craft of infrastructure-as-code. You script comfortably in Python or Bash, understand the nuances of alert design and SLOs for high-throughput APIs, and have spent enough time in production to know how distributed back-ends fail in the real world. Experience shepherding GPU-heavy workloads — whether with vLLM, Triton, Ray, or another accelerator stack — will serve you well, as will a background in MLOps or model-hosting platforms. Above all, you care about building self-healing systems, thrive on debugging performance from kernel to application layer, and enjoy collaborating with software engineers to turn reliability into a feature users never have to think about.

If the idea of safeguarding the infrastructure that powers tomorrow’s multimodal AI energizes you, we’d love to hear your story.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

titel: Technical Support Manager | Working Student / Werkstudent (m/w/d)
text:
Bei Superchat gestalten wir neu, wie Unternehmen mit ihren Kund:innen kommunizieren. KI wird dabei immer mehr zum Motor dieser Kommunikation. Integrationen sind das, was diesem Motor echte Power gibt: die Daten, Tools und Systeme, die aus einem cleveren AI-Agenten einen machen, der Prozesse wirklich automatisiert und Probleme löst.

Gegründet im Jahr 2020, ist Superchat heute die Plattform für über 10.000 Unternehmen weltweit - von bekannten Marken wie Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone und GASAG bis hin zu kleinen Unternehmen, Zahnarztpraxen und Solo-Founder:innen, die professioneller auftreten möchten.

Inzwischen laufen täglich Millionen von Nachrichten über Superchat.

Gestartet sind wir als Unified Inbox - ein zentraler Ort für alle Kommunikationskanäle wie WhatsApp, E-Mail, SMS oder Instagram. Mit dem Aufstieg von ChatGPT begann unser nächstes Kapitel: AI Agents, die über Chat, E-Mail und Voice in einer Qualität kommunizieren, die mit den besten menschlichen Teams mithalten kann.

Heute sind wir ein Team von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt 18 Millionen Euro Funding eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück - seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).

Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin. 

Als Werkstudent:in im Customer Support bist du die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kund:innen. Du löst ihre Anliegen im Live-Chat, koordinierst Eskalationen gemeinsam mit deinem Team und sorgst dafür, dass sich Unternehmen aus ganz unterschiedlichen Branchen und Regionen bei uns gut aufgehoben fühlen.

Why People Choose Us

  • Wir glauben an Zusammenarbeit vor Ort: Wir sind gerne gemeinsam im Berliner Office. Genau dort entstehen die besten Ideen, Entscheidungen werden schneller getroffen, wir lernen voneinander und wachsen als Team enger zusammen. Etwas Flexibilität für Remote Work bieten wir, aber unser Default und unsere Energie liegen im gemeinsamen Office-Alltag

  • Wir legen Wert auf Humbleness und Teamgeist - no Ego, offenes Feedback und die Bereitschaft voneinander zu lernen sind uns wichtiger als Titel

The team is scaling up right now: real scope, direct impact, no legacy.

YOUR MISSION

Data is the fuel of STARK’s AI stack - you build the engine that makes it usable. You own the software backbone of our data platform: the metadata systems, ETL pipelines, data contracts, catalogs, databases, and internal tools that let engineers find, understand, validate, and reuse terabytes of multi-sensor field data in minutes, not days. You treat data context as a product: structured, searchable, version-aware, documented, and traceable from raw recording to processed asset, annotation delivery, dataset, and downstream ML workflow. Success in this role requires seamless cross-functional collaboration—acting as the central hub between the teams collecting data in the field, our external annotation vendors, and the ML engineers training the models. Your job is to design the automated workflows and data tooling that unify these groups, transforming raw operational data into reliable, high-quality systems at scale.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Build the Data Backbone: Design, write, and maintain robust Python software and ETL pipelines that ingest, process, and merge complex field recordings (flight data, rosbags, video) and external deliveries into our GCP cloud storage.
  • Create Data Tooling: Build the programmatic tools that bridge raw data and downstream usage. This includes writing services to automatically sub-sample video feeds, extract valuable frames, package datasets, and build self-serve data access tools.
  • Database & Metadata Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain our metadata databases and data catalogs (tracking datasets, recordings, sensors, labels, and lineage) using solid SQL and schema design principles.
  • Data Operations & Labeling Workflows: Own the end-to-end technical workflows for data curation and labeling. You will build the operational tooling and coordinate with external labeling subcontractors to ensure high-quality data deliveries, track progress, and run automated QA.
  • Internal Tooling & APIs: Develop backend APIs, self-service dashboards, and data-access tools that allow the entire AI and engineering organization to quickly search, filter, and understand terabytes of multi-sensor data.
  • Drive Engineering Excellence: Establish and enforce good software engineering hygiene in a young codebase: rigorous testing, typing, documentation, logging, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Generalist Problem Solving: Thrive in an evolving startup environment. Take on ambiguous problems, migrate legacy data, handle access management, and aggressively automate away manual support tasks.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Strong Software Engineering in Python: You write clean, typed, tested, and maintainable Python code. You approach data problems with a software developer's mindset.
  • Data Engineering & ETL: Proven experience designing, building, and operating robust ETL/data ingestion pipelines.
  • Database Mastery: Solid SQL (PostgreSQL preferred) with a strong grasp of schema design, data modeling, and metadata systems.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with object storage (GCP/GCS, S3) and the basics of containerization (Docker) and CI/CD.
  • Unix/Linux Environments: Strong familiarity with Unix-based systems, shell scripting, and standard Unix tools. You are comfortable working natively in a Linux environment.
  • Pragmatic & Adaptable: You know how to balance a quick, scrappy fix with a long-term architectural solution, and you are highly comfortable with the changing priorities of a startup environment.
  • Communicator & Coordinator: You are comfortable working cross-functionally and coordinating with external vendors and non-technical stakeholders to drive data labeling and curation efforts.
  • Automation Mindset: You aren't allergic to jumping in to do support tasks, but you have the technical chops to automate them away so you never have to do them twice.

NICE TO HAVE

  • GenAI / Synthetic Data: Experience with synthetic data generation or GenAI-assisted workflows (auto-labeling, data augmentation, foundation-model-based curation).
  • Data Ecosystems: Familiarity with data versioning (DVC, LakeFS, FiftyOne), computer vision annotation formats (e.g., COCO), or large-scale data curation workflows.
  • Advanced GCP: Experience with GCP services beyond basic storage (BigQuery, Cloud Run, IAM).
  • Robotics / Complex Data: Exposure to robotics data formats (ROS bags, MCAP, PX4 logs) or handling heavy, multi-modal data streams (video, lidar).

titel: Staff Site Reliability Engineer - Sovereign Cloud
text: Meet DeepL DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation. Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures. Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination. What sets us apart What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected. When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture. What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog . Meet the team behind this journey You will join the team building and operating DeepL for Sovereign Markets, our offering for public sector bodies and regulated organisations that need more than data residency. It is hosted and operated entirely within the EU, under EU jurisdiction, and runs alongside DeepL's global infrastructure. The team is designing the platform foundations that make that promise true in practice: how services are built, deployed, secured, observed and operated. The approach favours managed infrastructure and well designed software abstractions over bespoke low level plumbing. You will work closely with product, security and legal colleagues as the offering grows to cover more capabilities and features. Your responsibilities Build the platform as software: Design and build the platform layer of DeepL for Sovereign Markets as software: reusable services, abstractions and tooling that product engineers build on Own the architecture: Own the architecture of the managed infrastructure the platform runs on, including Kubernetes, networking, storage, identity and secrets, using provider managed services where they meet the requirement Standardise and automate: Define infrastructure as code and delivery standards that hold across teams, and automate operations so that manual work is the exception Make design decisions visible and reviewable: write and review architecture decision records, weigh positions on their merits and commit once a decision is made Build for reliability: Build observability, resilience testing and incident response practices so that the service meets its reliability commitments Adapt the product to the new environment: Make low invasive modifications to existing code in the product with confidence in order to make it run in the new environment Keep the environment auditable: Work with security and compliance colleagues to keep the environment auditable and aligned with the standards our customers require Raise the technical bar: Mentor engineers, raise the technical bar through design reviews, and build consensus across teams without relying on line authority Participation in our on-call rotation: You’ll ensure the reliability and availability of our services by being available to join the team's shared on-call rotation as needed Qualities we look for Software engineering depth: Strong software engineering skills in at least one major language, C#, Go or Python preferred, shown by tooling, services or platform abstractions that other engineers rely on Production infrastructure: Production experience designing and running managed infrastructure and Kubernetes, with sound judgement on when to use provider managed services and when not to Automation and delivery: Infrastructure as code with Terraform, Crossplane or equivalent, and GitOps delivery, applied to environments you have owned AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving A track record of technical ownership across several teams: you create clarity where a mandate crosses team boundaries, hold clear positions and change them on evidence Reliability discipline: observability, incident response and designing for failure, with experience carrying on-call Security fundamentals: Working knowledge of infrastructure security fundamentals, such as identity, secrets, network segmentation and supply chain hygiene Clear written communication: you can capture a decision so that others can build on it You’d get bonus points for Experience in regulated or audited environments, for example BSI C5, ISO 27001 or SOC2 Experience with EU based or sovereign cloud providers Chaos engineering and game day practice Building platforms for small teams through a high degree of automation What we offer Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network. Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together. Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration. Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future. Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally. Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity. 30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally. Competitive benefits : just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way. If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you! We are an equal opportunity employer You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world. For us, this starts with our own culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment where every human can bring their whole self to work. Our clients are brands we believe in, from global big players to local heroes to startups we love. With each of our partners, we embark on a journey of co-creation, pushing the boundaries of what's possible and exploring the space where creativity and tech meet.

Our team of fun, welcoming, values-driven, and collaborative problem solvers has one focus at the heart of everything we do: human experience. Human experiences are the touchpoints where brands connect with customers. And we transform businesses by creating engaging, inspiring moments using strategy, creativity, data and technology - all backed by the global technological power of Infosys.

Experience, Tech & AI

We are a cross-unit and cross-location AI, tech and experience team. With more than 50 developers, AI engineers, technical artists and consultants working directly with other WongDoody teams, we are team players and specialists - both in frontend and backend, as well as in creative production pipelines. As part of Infosys, we belong to a leading global technology company with access to solutions and extensive know-how in the fields of commerce, marketing automation and AI.

Our local benefits

  • Flexible working hours and 100% overtime compensation
  • Work where it works for you. At home or in the office, or any mix you like
  • Working for strong brands and clients we believe in
  • 30 days vacation per year
  • Company Benefits
  • Urban Sports Club
  • Nice people in welcoming teams

What you can expect

  • Develop and maintain web applications and APIs (REST, GraphQL) in line with architectural, security, and code quality guidelines, using PHP, Python, and Node.js
  • Create technical concepts and proofs of concept (PoCs) as a basis for project estimates, and maintain technical project documentation
  • Implement serverless and server-based cloud hosting environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) using and improving our automated toolset
  • Build and orchestrate automated CI/CD pipelines based on GitLab, GitHub, Terraform, and Docker
  • Ensure the scalability, observability, security, and cost efficiency of the technical architecture
  • Maintain delivered solutions by monitoring their availability and providing necessary security and performance updates
  • Provide technical guidance and educate team members and colleagues on development and operations topics
  • Use AI assistants such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Review Bot, and a set of internal AI tools
  • Ensure high software quality for yourself and the team by actively participating in peer code reviews
  • Design, improve, and automate infrastructure for development teams

What we'd love to see

  • 5+ years of practical experience in commercial projects
  • A college or university degree in an IT-related field, or comparable education
  • Very strong technical knowledge of PHP and Python; Node.js is a plus
  • Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming, design patterns, and databases, both relational and document-based
  • Experience with Bash scripting is a plus
  • Good experience with Docker and a solid understanding of cloud-based infrastructures such as AWS and GCP
  • Expertise in DevOps tools and technologies, as well as designing and improving CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with Linux-based systems such as Debian, including secure provisioning and maintenance
  • Experience with automation tools for testing and infrastructure provisioning
  • Familiarity with agile project management processes such as Scrum or Kanban
  • Strong English skills are required
  • Good German skills are also a plus

text: Über uns Wir sind die LuxusKollektion, ein wachsendes Handelsunternehmen mit Sitz in Rosenberg im Ostalbkreis. Über zahlreiche Online-Marktplätze vertreiben wir Möbel, Wohnaccessoires und Haushaltsartikel in Deutschland, Frankreich, Italien, Spanien, Österreich und weiteren europäischen Ländern. Unser Unternehmen wächst kontinuierlich. In den vergangenen Monaten sind mehrere internationale Märkte hinzugekommen, weitere Expansionen sind bereits geplant. Mit unserem Wachstum steigen auch die technischen Anforderungen an unsere IT-Infrastruktur, unsere Systeme und die dahinterliegenden Prozesse. Unsere Plattform verarbeitet täglich Hunderttausende Produktangebote, Preise und Lagerbestände. Damit unsere Systeme jederzeit schnell, sicher und zuverlässig funktionieren, suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior DevOps Engineer, der unsere bestehende Infrastruktur betreut, weiterentwickelt und gemeinsam mit uns die technische Grundlage für unser weiteres Wachstum schafft. Du übernimmst dabei eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle und hast die Möglichkeit, unsere technische Infrastruktur aktiv mitzugestalten, Prozesse zu automatisieren und eigene Ideen einzubringen. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit unserem Team den Betrieb, die Weiterentwicklung und die Stabilität unserer technischen Infrastruktur. Betrieb, Verwaltung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Linux-Server und Docker-Umgebungen Aufbau, Optimierung und Wartung unserer Docker- und Docker-Compose-Stacks Überwachung und Optimierung unserer Datenbankinfrastruktur, insbesondere MariaDB Sicherstellung regelmäßiger Datenbank-Backups sowie Entwicklung und Pflege zuverlässiger Wiederherstellungsprozesse Aufbau, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unserer CI/CD-Pipelines und automatisierten Deployment-Prozesse Einrichtung und Optimierung von Monitoring-, Logging- und Alerting-Systemen Sicherstellung der Verfügbarkeit, Performance und Stabilität unserer Plattform und angebundenen Systeme Verantwortung für technische Sicherheitsmaßnahmen wie Zugriffskontrollen, Secret Management, Updates und System-Hardening Analyse und eigenständige Behebung technischer Probleme sowie nachhaltige Optimierung bestehender Systeme Automatisierung wiederkehrender Aufgaben und Prozesse, um manuelle Arbeit zu reduzieren und Abläufe effizienter zu gestalten Sicherstellung stabiler Schnittstellen und zuverlässiger Kommunikation mit angebundenen Marketplace-APIs Weiterentwicklung unserer bestehenden Infrastruktur im Hinblick auf Skalierbarkeit, Sicherheit und zukünftiges Unternehmenswachstum Identifikation technischer Schwachstellen und eigenständige Entwicklung geeigneter Lösungsansätze Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Team zusammen und bringst deine Erfahrung ein, um unsere Systeme langfristig stabil, sicher und leistungsfähig zu halten. Dein Profil Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung im Bereich DevOps, Linux-Systemadministration oder Infrastrukturmanagement mit und fühlst dich sowohl im operativen Betrieb als auch bei der technischen Weiterentwicklung von Systemen wohl. Mindestens 5 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Bereich DevOps, Systemadministration, Linux-Infrastruktur oder vergleichbaren technischen Positionen Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Administration und dem Betrieb von Linux-Systemen in produktiven Umgebungen Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit Docker und Docker Compose Gute Kenntnisse im Bereich Datenbanken, idealerweise MariaDB, einschließlich Performance-Optimierung, Backups und Wiederherstellung Erfahrung mit Netzwerkinfrastrukturen und deren Administration Praktische Erfahrung im Aufbau und der Pflege von CI/CD-Pipelines, idealerweise mit GitHub Actions Erfahrung mit Monitoring, Logging und automatisiertem Alerting Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für IT-Sicherheit, Zugriffskontrollen, Secrets Management und System-Hardening Freude an Automatisierung und daran, wiederkehrende Aufgaben durch sinnvolle technische Lösungen zu vereinfachen Eine strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise Verantwortungsbewusstsein und die Fähigkeit, auch bei technischen Störungen einen kühlen Kopf zu bewahren Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Bereitschaft, sich in bestehende Systeme einzuarbeiten und deren Weiterentwicklung aktiv voranzutreiben Idealerweise bringst du außerdem Erfahrungen mit folgenden Technologien und Bereichen mit: Node.js und Next.js n8n und Workflow-Automatisierung Tailscale und sichere Netzwerkverbindungen Automatisierte AI-Pipelines und deren Integration in bestehende Systeme Anbindung und Betreuung externer APIs, insbesondere von Online-Marktplätzen Du musst nicht jede einzelne Technologie aus unserem Stack perfekt beherrschen. titel: Working Student Data Engineer – Python, SQL & Cloud Platforms
text: IMPORTANT Application note Please apply only through this job portal. Kindly do not send applications or recruitment messages by email or LinkedIn. Only applications submitted through the portal will be considered. Thank you. About AgentixLake AgentixLake GmbH is a Data and AI engineering consultancy based in Hamburg, Germany. We design, build and operate production-grade data platforms and AI systems in our customers’ cloud accounts or on-premises environments. We are an AWS Services Partner and a Certified Services Partner in Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network. Our commercial focus is DACH and the Gulf region, alongside selected international opportunities. Your role Build the pipelines and data models that people can depend on. You will own defined components of our data engineering projects, from understanding a source system to delivering tested transformations and monitoring how they run. Our data platform engineering work connects operational systems with analytics and AI applications. Depending on the project, you will work with cloud warehouses, lakehouse architectures and the data quality and reliability practices that support production use. What you will do Build Python and SQL pipelines to ingest and transform data from APIs, databases, files or event sources. Develop data models and dbt transformations with clear definitions, tests and documentation. Implement incremental processing, schema checks and reconciliation so changes and data issues are visible. Configure orchestration and monitoring; investigate failed runs and improve recovery and troubleshooting. Contribute to cloud data platform components, infrastructure configuration and deployment workflows. Use Git, pull requests and code review to deliver maintainable changes and explain their impact on downstream users. What you bring Current university enrolment in computer science, data science, business informatics or a related technical discipline. Strong SQL and practical Python, supported by pipelines or data models you have built and maintained for actual users or team workflows. A sound understanding of data modelling, incremental loads, data quality and the operational behaviour of scheduled pipelines. Experience with version control and testing, plus practical exposure to a cloud platform, warehouse or orchestration tool. The ability to own a well-scoped deliverable, investigate problems systematically and communicate clearly in English. Experience with dbt, Airflow, Dagster, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Apache Iceberg or Terraform is valuable. You do not need experience with every technology; show us where you have developed depth. What you can expect You will work on data systems with clear users and delivery requirements, collaborate directly with experienced engineers and the founders, and receive substantive code review. Your part-time responsibilities and schedule will be planned around your studies. How to apply Use the Apply button on this page to submit your CV, current study details, location and weekly availability. Describe one pipeline or data model you delivered, the decisions you owned and how you tested or improved its reliability. An anonymised example is welcome; please do not share confidential client material. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If the core responsibilities match your experience, we would like to hear from you. Stay connected Follow AgentixLake on LinkedIn for practical engineering insights, project updates and future opportunities. Following is optional and does not influence recruitment decisions. titel: Senior Infrastructure Engineer – Azure, Active Directory & Hybrid Infrastructure (m/f/d)
text: Salary: €60,000–80,000 gross per year, depending on experience | Permanent | Immediate start | Remote within Germany or Switzerland (proximity to our Bexbach site is a plus) You want full ownership of a group's Azure and hybrid environment: not just tickets, but the architecture, the governance, and the direction it takes? Then help shape the infrastructure behind an international niche world leader in Omega-3 technology. Why join us? 🎯 Real ownership: You shape our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, drive technical decisions and take responsibility for its future development. 🌍 Remote-first: Work remotely from Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site and other group locations. 🤝 International collaboration: Join a small, hands-on Group IT team working closely with security, application teams and IT colleagues across our global sites. 🚀 Meaningful transformation: Play a key role in consolidating acquired IT environments and building a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure. 📚 Growth opportunities: Benefit from individual career and development opportunities in an internationally operating company. About us – in brief Headquartered in Bexbach, Germany, KD Pharma Group is a mid-sized, internationally active company and one of the world's few manufacturers of Omega-3 concentrates with a purity of up to 99.5%. Our expertise is built on a dedicated focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research, advanced purification technologies and manufacturing. With facilities and operations across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, we serve customers worldwide. Following a period of international growth through acquisitions, our focus is now on integrating and modernizing our IT environments to create a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure. Your Role – What You'll Own You will take hands-on ownership of our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, helping us move from independently managed site environments towards a standardized and centrally governed global IT platform. Working closely with the Group Director of IT, our security function, application development team and local IT colleagues, you will combine technical architecture with practical implementation. Your Responsibilities Infrastructure rationalisation: Simplify our distributed server estate, both on-premises and in Azure. Retire or replace unsupported systems, consolidate infrastructure and reduce technical debt across our sites. Active Directory & identity: Drive the consolidation and modernization of our Active Directory environments. Manage hybrid identity across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including directory synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication. Azure platform: Design, operate and continuously improve our Azure and hybrid environment, covering compute, networking, storage and core infrastructure services. Provide the application development team with the environments they need. Device management: Manage devices and applications across the group through Microsoft Intune, establishing consistent configuration, enrollment and security policies across all sites. Application delivery: Evaluate and implement the right delivery method for each application, starting with reducing our reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop. Governance and cost management: Establish clear Azure standards, policies and resource tagging. Ensure transparency of cloud spending and continuously optimize infrastructure costs. Resilience and monitoring: Ensure backup, disaster recovery and monitoring solutions are reliable, regularly tested and provide early warning of potential issues. Security partnership: Work closely with our security function to strengthen infrastructure security, implement appropriate controls, maintain patch compliance and resolve identified vulnerabilities. Infrastructure modernization: Review our existing infrastructure and determine which workloads should remain on-premises, move to Azure or be decommissioned. What You Bring We are looking for a hands-on infrastructure specialist who can independently manage and improve complex Microsoft environments. You combine strong technical expertise with the ability to drive infrastructure improvements across multiple locations. Must-have – Essential Requirements The following skills and experience are essential for this position: Azure & Hybrid Infrastructure Strong hands-on experience designing, operating and maintaining Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including compute, networking (VNets, NSGs, VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute) and storage. Proven experience managing on-premises Windows Server environments alongside Microsoft Azure in a hybrid infrastructure. Practical PowerShell scripting skills for automation, administration and infrastructure management. Infrastructure Modernization A proven track record of rationalizing infrastructure and reducing technical debt, including server consolidation, migration projects and replacing unsupported systems. Strong Windows Server administration skills, including server lifecycle management, upgrades and migrations. Practical experience with Hyper-V and/or VMware virtualization environments. Identity & Access Management Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in hybrid environments. Practical experience with identity synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication. Experience managing and improving identity security and access controls. Endpoint Management Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune in enterprise environments, including device enrollment, configuration policies and application deployment. Resilience, Security & Monitoring Practical experience with enterprise backup, disaster recovery and infrastructure monitoring solutions, ideally Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Monitor. Experience implementing infrastructure security improvements, including privileged access management, patch management, system hardening and vulnerability remediation. Communication & Collaboration Confidence working independently and across international teams and locations. Ability to explain technical concepts and architectural decisions to non-technical stakeholders. Good written and spoken English. German is an advantage. Willingness to travel occasionally to our Bexbach site and other group locations. Please note: This is a specialized infrastructure engineering role requiring proven hands-on experience with Azure, hybrid Microsoft environments and infrastructure modernization. The mandatory requirements listed above are essential for this position. Candidates without practical experience in these core areas are unlikely to be considered. Nice-to-have – Additional Experience The following skills are beneficial but not essential: Active Directory domain or forest consolidation and migration projects. Azure Virtual Desktop, particularly migrating users and applications to alternative delivery methods. Azure governance and cost management, including Azure Policy, resource tagging and Microsoft Cost Management. Azure Arc for managing on-premises servers. Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Identity or Microsoft Sentinel. Experience supporting application development teams, e.g. Azure App Service, Azure DevOps or GitHub. Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as Bicep or Terraform. Experience working in regulated environments, preferably pharmaceutical manufacturing or GxP. Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104, MD-102 or SC-300. Your First 12 Months Your initial focus will be on delivering measurable improvements across our global infrastructure: Assess and develop a roadmap for standardizing our Azure and hybrid infrastructure. Review and rationalize our existing server environments, replacing unsupported systems and reducing technical debt. Review our Active Directory and hybrid identity architecture and initiate consolidation where required. Strengthen centralized endpoint management through Microsoft Intune. Establish consistent Azure governance, resource standards and cost transparency. Improve infrastructure security, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery. Evaluate application delivery solutions and reduce unnecessary reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop. What We Offer Remote-first working: Work remotely within Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site. Competitive compensation: Annual gross salary of €60,000–80,000, depending on experience. Additional payments: Christmas and vacation bonuses. Company pension scheme: Support for your long-term financial security. Career development: Individual training and development opportunities in an internationally operating company. Employee benefits: Free water and coffee, as well as company products at employee prices. Team culture: Regular team events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across the group. 📍 Location: Remote within Germany or Switzerland (Bexbach proximity is a plus) 📅 Start date: As soon as possible ⏳ Employment type: Permanent, full-time Ready to Shape Our Global IT Infrastructure? We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership, make things better and deliver real technical improvements. Send us your application – no perfectly polished cover letter required. We are interested in your experience, your technical expertise and what you can bring to our team. We look forward to hearing from you! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

titel: IT Support Spezialist - Telematikinfrastruktur & Healthcare IT/APIs(x/f/m)
text: Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft Du hast ein starkes technisches Wissen und Lust, Dich tief in die deutsche Healthcare-IT einzuarbeiten? Dann bist Du hier richtig. Im Technical Services arbeitest Du an der Schnittstelle zwischen unserer Doctolib-Plattform und der deutschen Healthcare-IT-Landschaft. Du löst komplexe Integrationsprobleme, unterstützt unsere Kund:innen bei technischen Herausforderungen und trägst aktiv dazu bei, dass Doctolib reibungslos in die Infrastruktur unserer Kund:innen integriert ist. Du musst nicht vom ersten Tag an alles wissen. Mit Deinen fundierten Grundlagen und Deiner Motivation, unterstützen wir Dich, Dich in Themen wie die Telematikinfrastruktur und API/Konnektoren, einzuarbeiten. Deine Aufgaben Du bist technische Ansprechperson rund um die Deutsche Telematikinfrastruktur – von der Schnittstellen-Architektur über Kartenverwaltung bis hin zu Gematik-Standards. Kein Tag ist wie der andere. Produkte, die laufen: Du supportest Doctolib-Lösungen rund um die Deutsche Telematikinfrastruktur. und sorgst dafür, dass sie korrekt konfiguriert sind – und wenn doch mal etwas hakt, findest du heraus, warum. Komplexe Probleme, echte Lösungen: Interoperabilitätsprobleme mit Konnektoren und APIs gehören zu deinem Alltag – du arbeitest eng mit IT-Service-Partnern zusammen und bringst auch schwierige Fälle zum Abschluss. Tiefer tauchen, sauber dokumentieren: Du analysierst technische Herausforderungen eigenständig, hältst alles strukturiert in Jira fest und arbeitest direkt mit den Entwicklerteams zusammen, um Fehler nachhaltig zu beheben. KI als Werkzeug, nicht als Buzzword: Du nutzt KI-Tools aktiv, um schneller zu Lösungen zu kommen und Dir fundiertes Wissen aufzubauen – effizient und zielgerichtet. Wissen, das bleibt: Du teilst dein Know-how proaktiv mit internen Teams, damit Probleme gar nicht erst entstehen und unsere Kund:innen das bestmögliche Erlebnis haben. Dein Profil Das solltest du mitbringen: API-Integration und Troubleshooting sind für dich kein Neuland – du hast echte Erfahrung damit, Probleme zu identifizieren und zu lösen. Du kennst dich mit komplexen IT-Infrastrukturen, Netzwerken und sicherheitskritischen Systemen aus – und weißt, worauf es in solchen Umgebungen ankommt. Du kannst technische Sachverhalte so erklären, dass sie ankommen – egal ob du gerade mit einer Entwicklerin oder einer Praxismanagerin sprichst. Deutsch fließend (C1) und Englisch solide (B2) – du bewegst dich in beiden Sprachen sicher. Das ist ein Plus – oder du lernst es bei uns: Kenntnisse rund um die Telematikinfrastruktur, Gematik-Standards oder andere Healthcare-IT-Systeme – wer schon mal mit KIM+, eAU- oder E-Rezept-Workflows gearbeitet hat, ist klar im Vorteil. Erfahrung mit Observability-Tools wie Kibana, Datadog oder Elasticsearch. Ein Abschluss in Informatik, Medizinischer Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Berufserfahrung ist willkommen – aber kein Pflichtfeld. titel: Senior Network Engineer (all genders) – Cisco & Fortinet
text: Mit über 650 Kolleg:innen an 19 Standorten in ganz Deutschland gestalten wir bei teccle die Zukunft der IT. Seit 2020 bringen wir starke IT-Unternehmen mit unterschiedlichsten Schwerpunkten unter einem Dach zusammen - und entwickeln uns so zu einem der führenden IT-Dienstleister im Land. Unser Ziel: IT-Lösungen schaffen, die wirklich weiterhelfen - verständlich, flexibel und zukunftsfähig. Für unsere Kund:innen und gemeinsam mit einem Team, das Technik genauso liebt wie neue Ideen. Als Teil der teccle group steht die Braintower Technologies für innovative IT-Security- und Netzwerklösungen, sichere Business-Kommunikation sowie ganzheitliche Managed Services – von der Konzeption über die Implementierung bis zum laufenden Betrieb. Zur Verstärkung unseres 15-köpfigen, deutschlandweit verteilten Netzwerk-Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt engagierte Unterstützung. Was du bei uns bewegst Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was du kannst - sondern auch, was du bewirkst. In dieser Rolle trägst du zu folgenden Punkten bei: Planung, Implementierung und Optimierung komplexer Netzwerkinfrastrukturen bei unseren Kund:innen Eigenständige Umsetzung von Netzwerkprojekten , beispielsweise bei der Modernisierung von Netzwerkkomponenten, Optimierung von VPN-Verbindungen oder Erweiterung von Managed Services Analyse und Behebung komplexer Netzwerk- und IT-Störungen durch strukturiertes Troubleshooting und nachhaltige Lösungsansätze Sicherstellung eines stabilen Netzwerkbetriebs sowie schnelle Unterstützung bei kritischen Störungen und technischen Herausforderungen Technische Beratung unserer Kund:innen zur Weiterentwicklung ihrer IT-Infrastruktur, inklusive Analyse bestehender Umgebungen und Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen IT-Teams und Administrator:innen als technische Schnittstelle zwischen Kund:innen und verschiedenen Fachbereichen Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung technischer Dokumentationen sowie Einbringen eigener Ideen zur Optimierung von Netzwerklösungen und internen Prozessen Womit du bei uns glänzt Niemand erfüllt jede Anforderung. Wenn du neugierig bist und Lust auf die Aufgabe hast, freuen wir uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn nicht alles zu 100% passt. Du bringst langjährige Erfahrung im Network Engineering mit und kennst dich mit der Implementierung, Administration und dem Betrieb komplexer Datacenter-Netzwerke aus Du hast bereits Netzwerkprojekte eigenständig umgesetzt und überzeugst durch fundierte Erfahrung im Troubleshooting komplexer Netzwerk- und IT-Störungen Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Cisco ACI und hast idealerweise eine gültige Cisco CCNP-Zertifizierung Du besitzt eine gültige Fortinet NSE 4-Zertifizierung und hast praktische Erfahrung in der Konfiguration und Administration von Firewalls , beispielsweise von Fortinet oder Palo Alto Du arbeitest proaktiv , eigenständig und lösungsorientiert , überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Service- und Kundenorientierung und entwickelst dein Fachwissen gerne kontinuierlich weiter Du bringst idealerweise weitere Zertifizierungen in Cisco ACI, Fortinet (NSE 5 oder höher), Palo Alto oder LANCOM sowie Erfahrung mit Kund:innen aus regulierten Branchen mit Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch - im Team, mit Kund:innen und im Alltag Du lebst in Deutschland und bist berechtigt hier zu arbeiten - so können wir im Alltag gut und reibungslos zusammenarbeiten Darauf kannst du dich freuen Bei uns bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job. Wir wollen, dass du dich weiterentwickeln, wohlfühlen und mitgestalten kannst. Hier ein paar Gründe, warum du gerne bei uns arbeitest: Mehr Freiheit: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und bis zu 25 Tage arbeiten im EU-Ausland Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt: Ob im Büro oder von zuhause - du entscheidest, was für dich am besten funktioniert Wissen, das weiterbringt: Zertifizierungen, individuelle Weiterbildungen und Raum für deine Entwicklung Willkommenskultur mit Herz: Ein kollegiales Team und echtes Miteinander Gutes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Technik und klare Strukturen Sichere und faire Konditionen: attraktives Gehalt, JobRad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Unterstützung über meinEAP, unser kostenloses Beratungsangebot - auch für deine Familie Vielfalt macht uns stärker - deshalb fördern wir bewusst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen willkommen sind. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die unsere Haltung zu Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion teilen – und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns eine inklusive Arbeitswelt zu gestalten.
