bonial helps you save time, money and paper! We are a digital advertising partner for offline businesses - we support retailers in their marketing activities and help them find a new audience. Would you like to join and be a part of digitalisation of retail? bonial is part of Axel Springer SE and is disrupting the retail landscape as the leading "Drive to Store" partner in Germany and France. Through our platforms " kaufDA " and " MeinProspekt " in Germany, and “ Bonial ” in France, we connect millions of users with their favorite shops and brands—driving real impact every single day. We are in the midst of an exciting growth phase, scaling fast and transforming the way people discover retail. At bonial, we thrive in a high-performance, fast-paced environment fueled by motivated, results-driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference. If you’re looking to be part of a dynamic team that’s shaping the future of retail, we’d love to meet you. bonial welcomes both full- and part-timers! About The Role IT Operations keeps the company's core productivity, identity, and device ecosystem running smoothly and securely. As IT Systems Automation Engineer, you will own the design, implementation, and maintenance of automation across our corporate IT platforms (including M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, Microsoft Intune, Atlassian & Slack). You'll reduce manual work for the team, improve consistency and security across the employee lifecycle. You’ll help build the scripts, integrations, and workflows that let a 6-person team support the whole organization efficiently. This is a hands-on engineering role within IT Operations, not a helpdesk position - you'll spend most of your time building and improving systems rather than handling day-to-day tickets. What You’ll Do Automate the employee lifecycle: Design and maintain automated workflows for onboarding, offboarding, and role changes across M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, Intune, and Slack (provisioning/deprovisioning accounts, licenses, group memberships, and device enrollment) Device management: Build and maintain JAMF (macOS/iOS) and Intune (Windows/mobile) configuration profiles, compliance policies, and automated patch/update workflows. Identity & access automation: Automate group and license assignment, conditional access rules, and access reviews across M365 and Google Workspace, working closely with the security team where relevant. Collaboration tooling: Manage and automate Slack workspace administration - channel provisioning, app/integration approvals, user lifecycle, and usage policies. Scripting & integration: Write and maintain scripts (PowerShell, Google Apps Script, or similar) and use APIs to connect systems that don't natively integrate. Documentation & runbooks: Document automation logic, workflows, and recovery procedures so the rest of the team can support and extend what you build. Monitoring & reliability: Set up monitoring/alerting for automated workflows so failures (e.g., a broken onboarding script) are caught and resolved quickly. Continuous improvement: Identify manual, repetitive IT Operations tasks and propose/build automation to eliminate them. Vendor & tooling evaluation: Assess new automation tools or platform features (e.g., new Intune or JAMF capabilities) and recommend adoption where it adds value. Agentic support: Design, build, and operate AI agents that resolve common IT support requests end-to-end (e.g., password resets, access and software requests, device troubleshooting) via Slack or the service desk, connecting them to M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, and Intune through APIs, with clear guardrails, approval steps, human escalation paths, and audit logging. AI enablement: Roll out and administer AI tools across the organization (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude AI/Code, or similar), including license assignment, data access and governance settings, and usage policies, working closely with security, legal, and the works council where relevant, and support employees with onboarding guides, training materials, and best practices. What We’re Looking For Required: • Experience in IT Operations, Systems Administration, or a similar role with hands-on scripting/automation responsibility. • Practical experience administering at least two of: Microsoft 365 (Entra ID/Exchange/SharePoint admin), Google Workspace, JAMF, Microsoft Intune. • Working proficiency in at least one scripting/automation language (PowerShell, Python, Bash, or Google Apps Script) and comfort using REST APIs. • Understanding of core identity and device management concepts: SSO, MDM/UEM, conditional access, device compliance. • Ability to document processes clearly for a small team that needs to maintain what you build. Nice to Have: • Experience with Slack administration or Slack API/workflow automation. • Experience with a scripting/orchestration platform (e.g., Workato, Tines, Zapier, Azure Automation, or similar iPaaS tools). • Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft MS-102/MD-102, Jamf Certified Admin, Google Workspace Administrator). • Familiarity with security/compliance frameworks relevant to endpoint and identity management (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001). • Experience working on a small IT team where you own end-to-end delivery rather than a narrow slice of a larger org. What We Offer: High growth story - bonial is a high-growth and dynamic company with continuous potential into the future. We are a leading player and a driving force in an industry that is undergoing a massive and a once-in-a-lifetime shift from print to digital. Innovation & tech - we are a high-tech company focused on innovative technology, leveraging AI and other tools to maximize productivity and efficiency. We leverage these tools to continually enhance the performance of our company and our people, while driving results for our customers and users. Exciting environment for professional development - strong support for your professional development, backed-up by a feedback culture to help you identify your strengths and opportunities. Diversity - proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where we aim to enable everyone to show up as their full selves. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and to being a safe space regardless of race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender, gender identity or gender expression. Wellbeing - we believe mental health is as important as being fit. That's why we're giving you free access to nilo.health, a mental health app. In terms of physical training, other than our awesome gym in the office, we also cover part of the subscription to the Urban Sports Club. We can also offer you a corporate pension scheme so you don't have to worry about your retirement. Sustainability - together with our Green team, we offer you the opportunity to engage in projects that promote sustainability, environmental development and the impact that we make on our planet. Flexibility - Currently, we have a policy that allows for up to 20% mobile work, which can be conducted from anywhere within Germany, and the option to work from abroad. Additionally, we offer 28 days of holiday. You also get an extra day for each calendar year (up to 30 days) as well as other occasions (moving, working on a social project, etc).* Modern office - Zen Rooms where employees can pray, relax or simply have some quiet time; fully equipped gym in the office, and a roof terrace for amazing social events. Free lunch – whenever you’re at the office, we offer you different lunch options – and it’s all on us! Enjoy your lunch at a nearby restaurant that partners with us! Hot and cold drinks, fruit, regular varied and healthy breakfasts and other snacks at the office are, of course, always available for free for our employees.* Social Culture – which encourages people to start conversations, build relationships and participate together in the community through regular team events. Partner for retail - we empower retailers to reach their customers in the most efficient and effective way possible. We see ourselves as a critical business partner for retail, and as highlighted in our Company Vision, we “Enrich local shopping for everyone. Everyday.” As part of the Axel Springer Group, we also align with the Axel Springer Essentials . If you think you could fit the bill, we'd love to hear from you! You can check out our bonial_people Instagram or read more about bonial culture and tech on Medium . *as per our current Works Agreements Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Support-Hero & Problemlöser gesucht – Quereinstieg willkommen! Du hilfst einfach gerne anderen Menschen? Du tüftelst gerne an technischen Herausforderungen, bis sie gelöst sind? Dann passt du perfekt in unser Team! Als gewachsenes Tech-Unternehmen ist WIRECLOUD ein führender Anbieter von Cloud-Telefonanlagen. Wir suchen Verstärkung für unseren IT-Support, die Lust hat, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen. Dabei zählt für uns vor allem deine Einstellung und deine Motivation, anzupacken. Neben dem Kundensupport gehört auch die Bearbeitung von Behördenanfragen zu deinen Aufgaben. Dein Start bei uns Wir lassen dich nicht allein. Du bekommst ein strukturiertes Onboarding, bei dem du unser Team, die Systeme und die Welt der Cloud-Telefonie kennenlernst. Wir führen dich Schritt für Schritt an deine Aufgaben heran, und dein Aufgabenfeld entwickelt sich mit deinem Know-how ganz natürlich weiter. Deine Mission First Level Support: Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Bestandskunden bei Fragen rund um ihre Telefonanlage per Telefon und E-Mail (kein Sales!). Probleme lösen: Du hörst zu, analysierst technische Anliegen und hilfst dem Kunden geduldig weiter. Behördenanfragen: Du bearbeitest und dokumentierst eingehende Anfragen von Behörden nach klar geregelten Abläufen. Dein Profil Quereinsteiger sind bei uns ausdrücklich willkommen. Ein technischer Hintergrund ist ideal, aber kein Muss. Wichtig ist uns: Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt: Du hast schon im Support, in der Kundenberatung, im Service oder in einem anderen Job mit viel Menschenkontakt gearbeitet. Telefonieren ist für dich selbstverständlich, und du bleibst auch dann freundlich und geduldig, wenn es mal hakt. Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift: Unsere Kunden sind mittelständische Unternehmen aus Deutschland. Du erklärst ihnen technische Themen am Telefon und per E-Mail sicher und verständlich. Mittwochs in Köln: Wir arbeiten überwiegend im Homeoffice. Mittwochs kommt das ganze Team im Büro in Köln zusammen, und dieser Bürotag ist fester Bestandteil der Stelle. Eine reine Remote-Stelle können wir leider nicht anbieten. Zuverlässigkeit und Verschwiegenheit: Für die Arbeit mit Behördenanfragen ist eine einfache Sicherheitsüberprüfung (Ü1) nötig. Die leiten wir zu deinem Start ein. Bis sie abgeschlossen ist, arbeitest du erstmal nur im IT-Support. Zusätzliche Pluspunkte sammelst du hiermit: Technisches Interesse: Du hast idealerweise erste Berührungspunkte mit Netzwerkstrukturen oder VoIP/SIP-Technologien. text: Your Role You will help us build, operate and industrialize the storage foundation of our on-premise cloud platform. As part of a small, experienced team, you will own the Ceph clusters behind our block, object and file storage services – essentially the storage every customer workload eventually lands on. The platform is still actively being built, which means you will have real influence on the storage architecture, hardware lifecycle, automation strategy and technical direction. The role goes beyond Ceph itself: you will regularly work across bare metal, networking, OpenStack, Kubernetes and GitOps. As a Senior Engineer, you take ownership of your area and help make storage predictable, durable and highly automated as we scale into the petabytes Unser Tech Stack 🚀 · Ceph · OpenStack · Kubernetes · KVM · Linux · Bare Metal · Ansible · Terraform · Go · Cinder ·Neutron · Nova · RBD · Cilium · RGW/ S3 · Prometheus/ Grafana · FluxCD / ArgoCD · Git· Python · Claude Code · Cursor · Agentic Coding Tooling Your Responsibilities Design, operate and evolve our Ceph clusters for block, object / S3 and file storage - from CRUSH topology and failure domains to pool design, placement groups, erasure coding, capacity headroom and performance. Own the storage hardware lifecycle end to end – from qualification and burn-in through firmware, controller and disk health to OSD add/drain/replace, node retirement and hardware refresh. A key part of the job is automating these processes without creating tenant-visible impact. Automate the provisioning of storage nodes on OpenStack-managed bare metal , working with Ironic, RAID and disk configuration, SEDs, provider networks and VLANs. You will also own the artefact path around images, package mirrors, certificates and other dependencies needed to bring up clusters in environments with tightly controlled external connectivity. Run upgrades, rebalancing and reconfigurations as routine production operations, evolve our Infrastructure as Code and GitOps setup with Ansible, Terraform and FluxCD / ArgoCD, and make sure storage integrates cleanly with both OpenStack and Kubernetes. Own capacity planning and growth forecasting , use telemetry to understand real consumption, and build out monitoring, testing and failure-injection around performance, durability and security. AI-assisted engineering is simply part of how we work today. You use LLMs and agentic tools where they genuinely help – across development, testing, reviews, incident triage, knowledge retrieval or automation - and help us push further into self-healing and auto-remediation. Act as a technical reference and sparring partner across Ceph, storage, automation and AI tooling , document technical decisions and share your knowledge with the team. What we offer Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam Exciting work in a highly innovative and international environment with cutting-edge technologies 32 vacation days, increasing with length of service Flexible working hours, home office options, and a secure permanent position with market- and performance-based compensation Employer-funded pension plan and an attractive insurance package OVHcloud covers 50% of public transportation costs Up to €400 annual financial contribution from OVHcloud towards sports activities (gym membership, sports classes, etc.) Through Corporate Benefits, you receive attractive discounts at numerous shops and companies We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike Regular company events and free cold and hot beverages Several years of hands-on experience as an SRE, Storage Engineer or Platform Engineer running production storage infrastructure, with solid experience deploying, operating and debugging Ceph in production. You know the Ceph fundamentals from real-world operations: CRUSH, pools and placement groups, replication vs. erasure coding, BlueStore, scrubbing, recovery and backfill under load . You have managed storage infrastructure end to end , from the physical layer with drives, firmware, BIOS, controllers and hardware diagnostics through rebalancing, host drains, capacity expansion and hardware generation migrations. You are comfortable using Kubernetes as a control plane , not only as a workload runtime, and understand operators/controllers, custom resources, reconciliation and GitOps. You can also move confidently around OpenStack and debug issues involving Ironic, Neutron, Nova or Glance when needed. You have dealt with situations where durability really matters – such as degraded or near-full clusters, recovery under load or split-brain conditions – and you are used to making changes in a staged, evidence-based and reversible way. You have strong Linux and bare-metal skills , understand the block layer, filesystems and I/O behaviour, and are comfortable working with Ansible, Terraform and GitOps . AI-assisted engineering is already part of your day-to-day work. You have practical experience with LLMs and agentic tools and know where they can meaningfully support development, testing, reviews or operations. Ideally, you also bring experience with RGW / S3, RBD mirroring, CephFS or ceph-csi , deeper OpenStack storage integrations and Go and/or Python. Experience around VLAN/BGP, storage performance tuning, NVMe/BlueStore, observability, data protection, encryption, auto-remediation, security baselines or multi-site storage is also relevant for the role. You work autonomously, bring a strong sense of ownership , and are comfortable debugging problems where the actual root cause may sit somewhere between storage, networking, Kubernetes and OpenStack. You would rather verify what is happening from evidence than assume how the system should behave. We work in an international environment in English , so you should feel comfortable discussing technical topics, documenting decisions and working with the team in English. Wo es passt, verwenden wir vorhandene Plattform-Capabilities wieder, und wo etwas fehlt, entwickeln wir es neu. Der Stack läuft bereits produktiv. text: At our company, it's all about #OneTeam! Join gridscale and help shape the future of the cloud together with OVH. As a leading tech company, we've been working for over two decades to reduce our environmental footprint - with innovative solutions and an open cloud designed to be sustainable from the ground up: #SustainableByDesign. Within our #OneTeam, you'll shape the automation-first framework that lets every product team ship securely and at speed on top of OPCP, our On-Prem Cloud Platform. Our Tech Stack 🚀 · Kubernetes · GitOps · FluxCD / ArgoCD · Ansible · Terraform · OpenStack · Linux · CI/CD · Python · Bash · Go · Observability (Metrics, Logs, Traces) · LLMs · Agentic Coding Tooling Your Role💻 As a Site Reliability Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of platform engineering, AI-driven tooling and security by design. Together with your team, you'll build the framework to package and deploy software solutions on top of OPCP - turning vague product ideas into repeatable, observable and self-healing services. You'll work on the conception, automation and operation of the platform, drive continuous improvements and help new teams onboard with the framework and OPCP. Working hand in hand with developers, security specialists and AI researchers, you keep an overview in ambiguous situations, analyze systems and make well-founded decisions based on that analysis. AI-assisted engineering is part of our daily toolchain because it materially improves how we build and operate the platform – from spec-driven development with LLM assistance and knowledge-base-driven retrieval for incident response and design to agentic coding workflows and faster runbook authoring and review. We are investing in this direction as a structural part of our engineering practice and are looking for teammates who already work this way – not because it is trendy, but because they have seen it compound their own output. Your Tasks Design, build and maintain the Cloud Store packaging framework that standardizes how software is delivered on OPCP. Extend and evolve the AI substrate - LLM-driven code assistants, knowledge-base retrieval and agentic coding hooks - that amplifies our engineering output. Create and curate agentic coding environments : custom agents and sub-agents, slash commands, hooks and prompt engineering pipelines that become everyday developer tools. Own the knowledge-base layer that powers AI-driven incident response, design assistance and runbook generation. Drive our Kubernetes stack forward and implement robust GitOps pipelines (FluxCD / ArgoCD) for continuous delivery. Write, publish and continuously improve OPCP onboarding runbooks and best-practice guides for internal product teams. Analyze opaque system behavior, surface root causes and deliver concrete, data-backed improvement proposals - even when initial requirements are unclear. Develop, version and operate the Infrastructure as Code stack (Terraform, Ansible) that underpins the platform, and take part in our on-call rotation . In diesem Team gehst du am Ende eines Arbeitstages mit dem Gefühl nach Hause, einen sinnstiftenden Beitrag zur Digitalisierung des Gesundheitswesens geleistet zu haben – und entwickelst dabei deine Analyse-, Troubleshooting- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten enorm weiter. Deine Aufgaben Du unterstützt unsere Kund:innen im Second-Level-Support bei technischen Fragestellungen – innerhalb einer dreistufigen Supportstruktur. Du verantwortest die tiefgehende Analyse von Produkt- und Infrastrukturproblemen bei unseren Kund:innen und sorgst für eine schnelle und kundenorientierte Lösung. Du stellst internen Teams und Kund:innen dein Produkt- und technisches Fachwissen zur Verfügung. Du kommunizierst Probleme und Lösungen klar und prägnant an unterschiedliche Zielgruppen. Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Teams im Unternehmen zusammen, um Probleme zu beheben und Kundenfeedback weiterzugeben. Dein Profil Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir dich, dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen! Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst du Folgendes mit: Du verfügst über sehr ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in Fehleranalyse und -behebung und gehst analytisch an Probleme heran. Du bringst einen fundierten technischen Hintergrund im SaaS-Support mit. Du verstehst Konzepte rund um Computernetzwerke, SQL und Programmierung. titel: Software Integration & DevOps Intern / Working Student (m/f/d) Robotics Software
text:
The Industrial Automation and Robotics Application Department at Agile Robots is looking for a Software Integration & DevOps Intern / Working Student (m/f/d) Robotics Software.

Join our team in Munich, where you will help improve the user interface for our industrial mobile humanoid and the development workflows behind it. The challenge is to enable multiple project teams to contribute effectively using AI coding agents while keeping the shared software stable, consistent, and maintainable.

Responsibilities

  • Workflows & Automation: Establish practical workflows for AI-assisted development, with automated build, test, and code-quality checks.
  • Implementation Contracts: Define shared interfaces, implementation patterns, and agent instructions, and build automated checks and review workflows that verify contributions follow them.
  • Integration & Testing: Coordinate integration across project teams, maintain boundaries between project-specific and shared functionality, and improve regression tests for critical UI and runtime interactions.
  • Contributor Support: Keep development guidelines practical and current, and work with contributors across teams to resolve issues and improve development practices.

 

Your Profile

  • Background: Currently enrolled in a master’s program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Team Development: Experience contributing to a larger software development team, including shared code ownership, code reviews, and coordinating changes across contributors.
  • Git: Comfortable working with branches and pull requests, resolving merge conflicts, and reviewing other contributors’ changes.
  • Automation & Testing: Experience automating development checks and writing tests that catch meaningful regressions.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Communicate clearly with developers, application engineers, and project leads; explain technical issues, agree on practical solutions, and follow through across team boundaries.
  • AI Coding Agents: Demonstrated experience delivering software with AI coding agents while keeping it understandable and maintainable. Be ready to show how you established implementation rules, controlled the scope of changes, and verified that agents followed them.
  • Availability to mainly work on site in Munich (according to our policy max. 4 days remote work/ month)

 

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

text: At our company, it's all about #OneTeam! Join gridscale and help shape the future of the cloud together with OVH. Within our #OneTeam, you'll shape the automation-first framework that lets every product team ship securely and at speed on top of OPCP, our On-Prem Cloud Platform. Together with your team, you'll build the framework to package and deploy software solutions on top of OPCP - turning vague product ideas into repeatable, observable and self-healing services. You'll work on the conception, automation and operation of the platform, drive continuous improvements and help new teams onboard with the framework and OPCP. AI-assisted engineering is part of our daily toolchain because it materially improves how we build and operate the platform – from spec-driven development with LLM assistance and knowledge-base-driven retrieval for incident response and design to agentic coding workflows and faster runbook authoring and review. Create and curate agentic coding environments : custom agents and sub-agents, slash commands, hooks and prompt engineering pipelines that become everyday developer tools. Own the knowledge-base layer that powers AI-driven incident response, design assistance and runbook generation. Drive our Kubernetes stack forward and implement robust GitOps pipelines (FluxCD / ArgoCD) for continuous delivery. Write, publish and continuously improve OPCP onboarding runbooks and best-practice guides for internal product teams. Analyze opaque system behavior, surface root causes and deliver concrete, data-backed improvement proposals - even when initial requirements are unclear. Develop, version and operate the Infrastructure as Code stack (Terraform, Ansible) that underpins the platform, and take part in our on-call rotation . Hands-on experience operating production SaaS systems on AWS, with a strong grasp of AWS services and cloud architecture. Infrastructure as code, ideally with Terraform. A track record of building CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows, and of making developers faster. Production experience with monitoring, observability, and incident management. You can diagnose issues across infrastructure and application code. A strong understanding of distributed systems, networking, databases, and cloud security. Experience implementing security controls and supporting an external audit or certification such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001. Strong programming skills. You write maintainable code and build internal tools and automations that kill recurring work. You use AI in your daily development and actively look for workflows worth automating. Sound judgment about what to fix first and how much complexity a small team can maintain. You work independently and prioritize business impact. Working hours that overlap with CET ±2 hours. Nice to have Experience benchmarking infrastructure options or optimizing cloud costs. Familiarity with Salesforce or building integrations on top of it. Fix recurring problems at the root and regularly verify that we can recover from failures. Own the engineering side of security and compliance. Improve cloud access controls, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation. Maintain technical controls, gather evidence for our SOC 2 Type II audits, and drive engineering follow-up on audit findings. Improve how we build and ship. Own our CI/CD pipelines and make deployments and rollbacks safer. Make local development and staging easier to set up, use, and troubleshoot. Tackle new infrastructure challenges as we grow. Investigate problems across performance, scalability, and cloud costs. Prototype promising approaches, measure the results, and recommend what's worth putting into production. Why Weflow Real ownership : You set the direction for our platform from day one. No ticket queue, no layers of approval. Visible impact: Every reliability, security, or delivery win shows up directly in what customers experience and how fast we ship. A team that builds with AI: We use AI across the stack and want you to push that further in infrastructure. Every scalable, secure, and efficient product squad relies on a rock-solid infrastructure foundation. We are building resilient network and hardware layers that allow our platforms to operate securely and without avoidable operational disruption. We are looking for a Senior Hybrid Infrastructure Engineer who wants to take ownership of our foundational infrastructure. You will operate at the intersection of physical hardware and cloud environments, bringing reliability, advanced automation, and intelligent design to our core networks and datacenters.

💼 The Role

As a Senior individual contributor, you will be responsible for the design, operation, and evolution of our organization’s foundational infrastructure layers. You will not just maintain the status quo; you will own the standards for hyperscaler organization structure, network segmentation, and infrastructure automation across all environments. You will hold administrative access to cloud landing zones, network devices, core routing services, and bare-metal hosts. Working across both physical and virtual infrastructure layers, you will meticulously plan live system maintenance, verify operational readiness, and ensure that our core network paths and datacenter connectivity remain highly stable with minimal unplanned downtime.

🛠️ What You’ll Do

 

  • Hybrid Connectivity Design: Lead the design and maintenance of hybrid cloud connectivity, enterprise routing, failover patterns, and datacenter-to-hyperscaler interconnects.

  • Standardize & Automate: Own the standards for hyperscaler structures, network segmentation, and infrastructure automation. Maintain accurate infrastructure inventory, topology documentation, and operational runbooks.

  • Datacenter Operations: Guide hardware lifecycle planning, rack readiness, cabling standards, and physical deployment quality across datacenters.

  • Reliability & Capacity Planning: Review and improve system reliability, capacity planning, and risk management. You will proactively scale and document hybrid infrastructure architecture before bottlenecks emerge.

  • Strategic Collaboration: Partner closely with Platform Engineering, Security, and application teams to expose infrastructure capabilities in a secure, consistent, and sustainable way.

  • Disciplined Execution: Execute critical infrastructure changes prioritizing safety and operational readiness. Support structured change reviews, maintenance planning, and rigorous change control practices.

 

✨ What You Bring

 

  • Deep Technical Expertise: Advanced expertise in Linux/Unix administration, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), and enterprise networking protocols (BGP/OSPF).

  • Hybrid Infrastructure Mastery: Strong practical experience with cloud landing zone design, network topology management, hybrid interconnect design, and datacenter hardware operations.

  • Automation & AI Literacy: Proficient in Infrastructure as Code and configuration automation. You intelligently leverage AI-assisted tooling for network diagnostics and automation while maintaining strict review discipline and awareness of AI-generated risks in privileged tooling.

  • Safety-Conscious Ownership: Highly methodical and detail-oriented. You possess a strong sense of ownership and change discipline for live system maintenance and production network changes.

  • Proven Track Record: Experience heavily contributing to production hybrid infrastructure at scale. You have successfully reduced manual effort through standardization and executed low-risk infrastructure projects (such as secure datacenter-to-cloud migrations).

  • Effective Communication & Mentorship: Ability to troubleshoot production-grade issues under pressure. You clearly communicate capacity, risk, and downtime planning with stakeholders and naturally mentor peers in infrastructure best practices.

 

💡 What We Offer

 

  • High-Impact Ownership: Administrative authority over cloud landing zones, network devices, bare-metal hosts, and core routing services to shape the foundation of our platform.

  • A Culture of Engineering Excellence: An environment that values clean topology modeling, resilient routing, and automation over manual configuration.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: A highly collaborative setup working alongside Platform Engineering and product squads to deliver secure, foundational capabilities.

Deine Aufgaben Für ein langfristiges Kundenprojekt suchen wir einen Senior Azure Cloud DevOps Engineer (gn). Du entwickelst und betreibst skalierbare, sichere Azure-Cloud-Plattformen und modernisierst die Engineering- und Entwicklungstools internationaler Teams. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Automatisierung der Infrastruktur, der Weiterentwicklung von CI/CD-Pipelines und der Bereitstellung cloudnativer Services. Du konzipierst, implementierst, administrierst und betreibst Azure-Cloud-Infrastrukturen und -Services. Du automatisierst Infrastruktur und Deployments mit Terraform und OpenTofu und administrierst und optimierst Kubernetes-Plattformen. Du entwickelst, pflegst und optimierst CI/CD-Pipelines und setzt GitOps-Konzepte mit FluxCD und ArgoCD um. Du entwickelst C#/.NET-Anwendungen und Engineering-Tools, stellst sie bereit und integrierst und betreibst sie in der bestehenden Toollandschaft. Du überwachst die Plattformen, analysierst und behebst Störungen, koordinierst Incidents und führst Root-Cause-Analysen durch. Du optimierst die Performance der Cloud-Infrastruktur und unterstützt Cloud-Migrationen und Modernisierungsvorhaben. Du setzt Cloud-Sicherheitskonzepte um und arbeitest im Identity- und Secrets-Management mit Keycloak und HashiCorp Vault. Du arbeitest mit internationalen Entwicklungs- und Betriebsteams in einem agilen Umfeld zusammen. Bei New Monday setzen wir auf kurze Abstimmungswege und Vertrauen. Aufgaben mit Wirkung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst deine Erfahrung direkt im Kundenprojekt ein und gestaltest digitale Prozesse mit, die den Netzausbau und die Integration von Erzeugungsanlagen unterstützen.
